issue_title: Vapor: a falsy v-if inside <component :is> renders the SSR placeholder as <!--v-if--> and vapor hydration reports a children mismatch
issue_body:
### Vue version 3.6.0-rc.6 ### Link to minimal reproduction https://github.com/denismrte/vapor-dynamic-component-vif-hydration ### Steps to reproduce Steps to reproduce pnpm install pnpm verify verify.mjs server-renders five variants of one template, hydrates each in headless Chromium and prints what each did. It exits 0 when the bug signature is present, 1 when it is absent, 2 on a harness failure. The failing component, src/Fail.vue. The button only proves the app is live. Server: renderToString(createSSRApp(App)). Client: createVaporSSRApp(App).mount('#app'). ### What is expected? Hydration adopts the server tree unchanged, as it does for the same v-if under a static tag, and as it does for the same dynamic tag compiled as a vdom component. ### What is actually happening?

What is actually happening?

[Vue warn]: Hydration children mismatch on div — Server rendered element contains more child nodes than client nodes.

The empty branch of the v-if is written into the SSR stream as a named comment inside a dynamic component and as the anonymous placeholder under a static tag:

case | empty-branch placeholder in server HTML | mismatch reported -- | -- | -- vapor, falsy v-if inside |   | yes vapor, the same over v-for |   | yes vapor, the same over v-for inside a |   | yes, one per empty branch vapor, the same v-if under a static tag |   | no vdom, falsy v-if inside |   | no

Every arm stays interactive: the page hydrates and then reports the mismatch.

Failing case — server, then the DOM after hydration:

<!--[--><button id="bump">bump</button><p id="clicks">0</p><div><!--v-if--></div><!--]-->
<!--[--><button id="bump">bump</button><p id="clicks">0</p><div><!--if--></div><!--dynamic-component--><!--]-->

The static-tag control, for contrast — the placeholder differs and hydration is clean:

<!--[--><button id="bump">bump</button><p id="clicks">0</p><div><!----></div><!--]-->
<!--[--><button id="bump">bump</button><p id="clicks">0</p><div><!----></div><!--]-->

Browser output for the failing case:

[Vue warn]: Hydration children mismatch on div
Server rendered element contains more child nodes than client nodes.
  at <Fail >
Hydration completed but contains mismatches.

Neither v-for nor <TransitionGroup> is required to trigger it. The loop case adds v-for to the dynamic element; the group case puts a keyed v-for inside a <TransitionGroup> under it and reports one Hydration children mismatch on div.cell per row whose conditional branch is empty — three of its four rows — under <VaporTransitionGroup ...>; that is the practical shape, and the reason this reads at first as a <TransitionGroup> problem.

System Info

  System:
    OS: macOS 26.4.1
    CPU: arm64
  Binaries:
    Node: 24.19.0
    pnpm: 11.22.0
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 152.0.7977.64
  npmPackages:
    vue: 3.6.0-rc.6
    vite: 8.2.2
    @vitejs/plugin-vue: 6.0.8
### System Info ```shell System Info System: OS: macOS 26.4.1 CPU: arm64 Binaries: Node: 24.19.0 pnpm: 11.22.0 Browsers: Chrome: 152.0.7977.64 npmPackages: vue: 3.6.0-rc.6 vite: 8.2.2 @vitejs/plugin-vue: 6.0.8 ``` ### Any additional comments? The two comment shapes are not interchangeable to vapor hydration and are to vdom hydration, so the dynamic-component SSR path and the vapor hydration path disagree about which placeholder marks an empty v-if branch. The practical shape this was first met in is a list whose group wrapper switches between section and div by data, with a conditional badge inside each row: the page hydrates and then reports one children mismatch per row, and the only workaround is to freeze the wrapper to a static tag.
